# Vendored libFLAC

A trimmed copy of [libFLAC](https://github.com/xiph/flac), compiled directly
into the `zflac` module by `build.zig`.

Upstream: `https://github.com/xiph/flac`, branch `master`, commit
`e94ff9f68b8e7dbd3e9f8b1ac18a8eca1914f181`, project version **1.5.0**.
Nothing here is modified except `config.h`, which is ours.

Re-copy it with `./vendor/re-vendor.sh /path/to/flac` (see that script for the
exact file list). After re-vendoring, check the release notes and run
`zig build test`.

## What was taken

15 translation units from `src/libFLAC` — everything the stream encoder and
decoder need, and nothing else:

```
bitmath.c bitreader.c bitwriter.c cpu.c crc.c fixed.c float.c format.c
lpc.c md5.c memory.c stream_decoder.c stream_encoder.c
stream_encoder_framing.c window.c
```

plus the two `deduplication/*.c` fragments that `bitreader.c` and `lpc.c`
`#include` even in a portable build, and `src/share/win_utf8_io/win_utf8_io.c`,
which `build.zig` compiles only for Windows targets because `compat.h` routes
libFLAC's file helpers through it.

Headers: the seven public `FLAC/*.h` the bindings `@cImport`, the `share/*.h`
those pull in, and `src/libFLAC/include/{private,protected}/*.h` as needed.

Left out: Ogg (`*_ogg*`, `ogg_*.h`), the metadata object API
(`metadata*.c`, `metadata.h`), seektable/cue-sheet/picture support, the
replay-gain and UTF-8 I/O helpers, all the SIMD kernels
(`lpc_intrin_*.c`, `cpu.c`'s asm paths), and the `flac`/`metaflac` tools.

## config.h

Upstream's `config.h` is generated by CMake; this one is written by hand. The
important decisions:

| define | value | why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PACKAGE_VERSION` | `"1.5.0"` | keeps `FLAC__VERSION_STRING` reproducible |
| `FLAC__HAS_OGG` | `0` | no Ogg container |
| `FLAC__HAS_X86INTRIN` / `FLAC__HAS_NEONINTRIN` / `FLAC__HAS_A64NEONINTRIN` | `0` | the SIMD kernels are not vendored; `build.zig` also passes `-DFLAC__NO_ASM` |
| `ENABLE_64_BIT_WORDS` | `0` | bit reader works on `uint32_t`, halving its state on 32-bit targets |
| `HAVE_FSEEKO` | `1` | needed to compile the file-based init paths; `-DFLAC__NO_FSEEKO` opts out |
| `HAVE_PTHREAD` / `HAVE_C11THREADS` | undefined | the encoder stays single-threaded |
| endian macros | from `__BYTE_ORDER__` | no configure step to detect it |

`build.zig` adds `-DHAVE_CONFIG_H=1 -DFLAC__NO_DLL=1 -DFLAC__NO_ASM=1`, and
`-DNDEBUG=1` unless `-Dflac-assertions` is on.

## Allocator hooks

libFLAC 1.5.0 has no runtime memory callbacks, so allocation is redirected at
compile time: `build.zig` passes
`-Dmalloc=zflac_malloc -Dcalloc=zflac_calloc -Drealloc=zflac_realloc -Dfree=zflac_free`
and `src/flac/alloc.zig` provides those symbols on top of a Zig allocator.
Turn it off with `-Dflac-alloc-hooks=false`.
